description.value: Quails' Gate Estate Winery has been growing and crafting award-winning wines on Boucherie Road since 1989, when the Stewart family planted their first vines on this Okanagan Lake-side estate. The property combines a daily-open wine shop and guided tasting experiences with the acclaimed Old Vines Restaurant, offering farm-to-table cuisine alongside sweeping lake and vineyard views. On-site accommodations at The Lake House and The Nest make this a natural overnight destination for touring cyclists exploring the West Kelowna wine-route corridor.
